reason: ListPolicies defaults to Scope=All, which returns ~1600 AWS-managed policies alongside a handful of ours. Scope=Local keeps only customer-managed ones; OnlyAttached keeps only those actually attached to a role, user or group. An unattached policy is not part of the running estate.
DescribeImages with no Owners returns EVERY public AMI in the region - hundreds of thousands of rows that are not our assets. `self` scopes it to images this account owns.
DescribeSnapshots with no OwnerIds returns every public snapshot in the region. Same failure mode as AMIs, and the same fix.
Shares we own. The OTHER-ACCOUNTS side is collected separately as shared-in resources.
ListDocuments with no filter returns every SSM document AWS publishes - thousands of them, none owned by this account. Owner=Self scopes it to ours.
